eager_path_gaps.cuLaunchKernel_intercept: NOT A GAP — CUPTI traps all 23318 launches in steady-state (ratio 23.94x warmup)
eager_path_gaps.cuLaunchKernelEx_intercept: NOT A GAP — CUPTI traps both forms
eager_path_gaps.ATen_SDPA_dispatcher: PARTIAL GAP — substrate has trampolines but vLLM uses FlashAttention (flash_attn module direct, not via ATen). Closing requires intercepting flash_attn's CUDA-side entry points (cuda::launch or direct kernel-driver calls).

graph_mode_gaps_UNTESTED.reason: vLLM default cudagraph_mode=FULL_AND_PIECEWISE SEGFAULTS under cipher-platform v2.0 substrate (F-CUDAGRAPH-1: KV VMM allocator vs graph capture incompat). enforce_eager=True was set to isolate substrate health from graph compatibility. THIS MEANS: H2 (graph blind spot) is UNANSWERED by this measurement; production customers using cipher-platform .deb today are FORCED to eager mode (or hit F-CUDAGRAPH-1).
graph_mode_gaps_UNTESTED.cuGraphLaunch_intercept: PRESUMED GAP — substrate's cuLaunchKernel CUPTI trap does NOT fire when graph is replayed via cuGraphLaunch (graph nodes execute internally on GPU). Production impact: eager mode customers OK (this measurement); graph mode customers blocked by F-CUDAGRAPH-1 today.
graph_mode_gaps_UNTESTED.cuGraphAddKernelNode_intercept: PRESUMED GAP — per-kernel actuator routing decisions during graph capture cannot fire without intercepting node addition.
graph_mode_gaps_UNTESTED.cuGetProcAddress_intercept: GAP — substrate dlsym_intercepts=0 throughout. Modern CUDA uses cuGetProcAddress lazy resolution which bypasses both LD_PRELOAD constructor and dlsym hook (R-A.1 finding at Phase A; CUDA_INJECTION64_PATH path used as workaround). v2 driver-API substrate needs explicit cuGetProcAddress wrapper to catch direct-driver callers.

v1_production_disposition.eager_mode_customer: FULL substrate coverage on cuBLAS + CUPTI launches; actuator engagement gated by workload-class predicates not coverage
v1_production_disposition.graph_mode_customer: BLOCKED by F-CUDAGRAPH-1 (segfault) — needs either (a) graph-compat VMM allocator OR (b) graph capture path through plugin/substrate
